metadata.case_name: MUHAMMAD RIAZ KHAN v. COMMISSIONER OF CORRECTIONAL SERVICES

source: At QMH, the plaintiff was found to have a fracture of left nasal bone.

injuries.description: Internal and external bleeding of the nose
source: The plaintiff sustained a fracture of the nasal bone, internal and external bleeding of the nose and neck injury.

injuries.description: Neck injury; cervical spondylosis (pre-existing degenerative disorder of the cervical spine) with aggravation
source: The plaintiff sustained a fracture of the nasal bone, internal and external bleeding of the nose and neck injury.
He had received treatment at QMH and was diagnosed as having cervical spondylosis (ie degenerative disorder for the cervical spine).

Dr Yeung opined that his cervical spondylosis would have deteriorated to his current extent even if the subject accident had not occurred. The October 3 incident probably had advanced such changes by about 1 year. Dr Yeung further opined that the October 3 incident should be responsible for half of the impairment due to his neck problem.

injuries.description: Left shoulder pain and stiffness; frozen shoulder features
source: After the October 3 incident, the plaintiff complained of left shoulder pain. X-ray examination found no bony lesion in his left shoulder.
At the time of the joint medical examination on 25 November 2014, the plaintiff was suffering from typical symptoms of "frozen shoulder"
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the shoulder or upper arm

injuries.description: Superficial bruises, abrasions and patches of redness to face, arms and chest
source: Both eyes redness, visual acuity intact;
Patch of redness over left shoulder (posterior aspect), size 4cm x 3cm;
Patch of redness over anterior chest, size 3cm x 3cm;
Left mid-arm region, patch of bruise and redness, superficial abrasion, size 3cm x 3cm;
Patch of circular area of redness over right mid-arm, size 3cm x 3cm; and
Linear superficial redness over left forehead region.

manifestations.description: Both eyes redness, visual acuity intact
Nasal stuffiness and difficulty in breathing whenever he lied down
Neck stiffness and neck pain with radiation to the left trapezius region and upper back
Left shoulder pain associated with significant stiffness (frozen shoulder symptoms)
Superficial abrasion and patches of redness over arms, chest and forehead

treatments_received: He was admitted to Queen Mary Hospital ("QMH") for treatment.
He was given a neck collar for the support of his neck.

losses.description: General damage awarded for injuries to the nose and the neck (pain, suffering and loss of amenity) in the sum of $60,000 after deduction for pre-existing condition.
